name: Navès (Spain)
description: Horizontally divided white over red, charged at the centre with a green dragon with a red tongue.
history: The official flag of Navès is oblong, of proportions two high by three long, divided horizontally into two equal stripes, white above and red below, and over all at the centre a green dragon with a red tongue of height 7/9 of the cloth; approved on 30 July 1998 and published in the DOGC on 31 August 1998, with a correction to the blazon in 2001.
